ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to restrict hospitalization cost products to the matching product year.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Setup.Data_Migration_Check__c.Bypass_Flow_Validations__c = FALSE, RecordType.Name = 'Hospitalization', !ISBLANK(Service_Provided_by_Facility__c), !ISBLANK(Date_of_Admission__c), OR( /*BCMOHAM-35966: Historical consolidated products (start 1998-04-01) are allowed for admissions within their range; block only when the admission is on or after the product's end date */ Service_Provided_by_Facility__r.Effective_Start_Date__c = DATE(1998, 4, 1) && Date_of_Admission__c >= Service_Provided_by_Facility__r.Effective_End_Date__c,
AND( NOT(Service_Provided_by_Facility__r.Effective_Start_Date__c = DATE(1998, 4, 1)), MONTH(Date_of_Admission__c) < 4 , !CONTAINS(Service_Provided_by_Facility__r.Name, TEXT(YEAR(Date_of_Admission__c))) ), AND( NOT(Service_Provided_by_Facility__r.Effective_Start_Date__c = DATE(1998, 4, 1)), MONTH(Date_of_Admission__c) > 3 , !CONTAINS(Service_Provided_by_Facility__r.Name, TEXT(YEAR(Date_of_Admission__c) + 1)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The product must match product year for hospitalization costs.
